stemMd: A straight access ramp is inclined at $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal and is $8\ \text{m}$ long, measured along the slope. By how many metres does it raise a person who walks up its whole length?
explanationMd:
**What to notice first.** The 8 m is measured along the slope, so it is the hypotenuse of a right triangle. The height gained is the side *opposite* the $30^{\circ}$ angle.

**The step that settles it.** Opposite over hypotenuse is the sine:

$$\text{height}=8\sin 30^{\circ}=8\cdot\frac12=4\ \text{m}.$$

**How to check it.** In a $30^{\circ}$–$60^{\circ}$–$90^{\circ}$ triangle the side opposite $30^{\circ}$ is half the hypotenuse, so 4 m. The horizontal run is then $4\sqrt3\approx 6.9$ m, and $4^{2}+(4\sqrt3)^{2}=16+48=64=8^{2}$. Any height greater than the ramp's own length can be rejected immediately.

distractorRationale.d: Uses the cosine of $30^\circ$ instead of the sine. $8\cos 30^\circ = 4\sqrt3$ is the horizontal distance covered, not the height gained.
distractorRationale.e: Treats the 8 m as the horizontal leg and uses the tangent: $8\tan 30^\circ$. But 8 m is measured along the slope, so it is the hypotenuse.
distractorRationale.b: Uses no trigonometry and takes the height to equal the length of the ramp. The height is only the length of the ramp when it is vertical.
distractorRationale.c: Divides by $\sin 30^\circ$ instead of multiplying, giving $8 \div \tfrac12$. A ramp cannot raise a person by more than its own length, so this is impossible.

accessibilityText: A straight ramp is inclined at thirty degrees to the horizontal and is eight metres long along the slope. Find the vertical height it gains. The choices are: four; eight; sixteen; four times the square root of three; and eight times the square root of three divided by three, all in metres.

independentSolve.workingNotes: The rise is 8 sin 30 = 4 m. D (4*sqrt(3)) is the horizontal run 8 cos 30, E is 8 tan 30, B is the slope length itself and C doubles it. The stem clearly says the 8 m is measured along the slope, so only 4 is the rise. [A second, separate blind solve (blind-reviewer-wave7-tila-maths-physics-run1) reached the same answer: Height = 8 sin 30 = 4 m. D (4 * sqrt(3)) is the horizontal run from cos 30. E is 8 tan 30, B is the slope length, and C is 8 / sin 30.]
